second_scroll_root_cause: Review-generation child rows lacked stable DOM keys. syncHistoryChildren therefore matched unkeyed rows positionally; insertion, removal, or status/path expansion in a large review-generation list could reuse the wrong row and alter layout during polling. The existing lastUserHistoryScrollAt guard was preserved.
fix: Render data-generation-id from generation_id/job_id and reconcile it in historyRenderKey.
